name: device.outputs.stream
description: Persistent shared desired-output stream. Connect /control using stream.open credentials. JSON metadata: type="desired", authority/generation/epoch from stream.open, increasing integer sequence, outputs={"mask":N}, issued_at/expires_at numeric UTC Unix seconds; issued_at<=router_now<expires_at<=issued_at+1. A400ms intent uses expires_at=issued_at+0.4. Channels1forward(mask1),2back(mask2),3left(mask4),4right(mask8); mask0stop. Binary uses4-byte big-endian JSON length then the same metadata. Errors reply STREAM_REJECTED with reason and non1000 close; ACK is commanded state, not measured motion. No PWM; speed-duration curve uncalibrated.
